scope: Isolated browser lifecycle checks of the served production createLifeTutor module used by home, not a full home-flow or visual test.

baseline.method: Three isolated components with reduced:true and practiceCompleted:true; setActive(false), setActive(true), advance 20000ms.

checks.name: success face and one listener per lifecycle source
success held for configured reaction time
success returns to baseline without stale body animation
reduced motion preserves authored success feedback
baseline regression fixed: deactivate/reactivate during reduced success
reactivation resumes exactly one blink cycle
manual reduced mode closes pending blink safely
manual reduced mode has no automatic blink
OS reduced change clears current blink before normal 130ms reopening
OS reduced mode has no automatic blink
dispose removes document and media listeners
disposed tutor unaffected by later motion event
